usedFor: Trafft holds the appointments and customers, HubSpot receives them as deals, and “Appointment Booked” can start “Create Deal”.

bestTemplate.name: “Appointment Booked” in Trafft, then “Create Deal” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: It opens a deal in HubSpot when a Trafft appointment is booked.

watchOut: “Appointment Rescheduled” can also reach “Create Deal”, so use “Update Deal”, which needs the deal ID, for changes.
